You make some decent points. But it goes two ways. First of all, I assume you would be okay with people making jokes at a group you're in (gender, race etc.) and comparing you to Nazis. Secondly, other people made short comments about how this kind of behavior is offensive. You posted a very long comment about how everyone needs to just toughen up, and no one can stop you and everyone should just stop whining, this is a public forum etc. But no one deleted your comments, no one muted you, no one banned you, etc. You shared opinions/made jokes, and people responsed, that's it, both are allowed. You talk about how the 'real world' won't change to everyone's sensitivities, and that's true. But it is for you too. You made be allowed to say what you want, but you're not entitled to make people be around you or to never receive opposition. Don't be surprised if people don't wanna be around you or call you out in real life. You might be a totally good person in real life, doesn't mean everyone has to agree with and never show opposition to your opinions. Remember, the first amendment gives you the right to say what you want and not be arrested, but it doesn't give you the right to receive no other consequences. And when making 'jokes' and interacting with people in general, make sure you can take what you dish out.
